item.title: Middle East live: Israel deports all foreign activists from Gaza flotilla amid global backlash
item.description: The Israeli government said Thursday that hundreds of flotilla activists, including all foreign nationals, who attempted to breach Israel's naval blockade of Gaza this week have all been released from detention and deported. It followed an international outcry over a video clip of Israeli National Security Minister Itmar Ben-Gvir heckling the detained activists as they were bound and kneeling. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

item.title: Israel's Ben-Gvir sees 'no innocent people in Gaza or even Europe': Journalist Gideon Levy
item.description: FRANCE 24's François Picard welcomes veteran Israeli journalist and Haaretz columnist Gideon Levy. He offers a scathing analysis of Israeli politics, the Gaza war, the unprecedented rise of xenophobic nationalism and Israel's growing dependence on the United States. Speaking from Tel Aviv amid mounting electoral tensions, Levy argues that "everything – war and peace, domestic politics, legislation – is now covered by the shadow of the upcoming elections".
